Heat in Phnom Penh

Phnom Penh

A capital of garment factories and metal roofs, hottest before the rains.

What heat does here

68% → 88%

of workers at three garment factories reported heat symptoms, from the cooler months to the hot months.

What is in place

A city plan in preparation

A proposal with the national weather ministry and Phnom Penh Capital Hall would set heat thresholds and response protocols.

What helps

Cooler factories protect workers, and the work.
